services.name: Bay Clamming (Walking Tour)
services.desc: Grab the family and head out at low tide to gather some tasty Cockles and Butters, perhaps even a Gaper clam. Our guide will take you to the spot, provide tools and instruction to teach you how to harvest your own fresh seafood from the bay. No boat

services.name: Garibaldi Target Lingcod and Crabbing
services.desc: June only Our 8 hour Target Ling Cod Fishing Trip specifically targets these tasty and tender white meat fish. Please note - this trip may be nearshore or offshore depending on weather and fishing conditions. Lingcod is one of the most prized bottom fish on the Oregon Coast and is our main goal - but you’ll also see plenty of action from the rockfish. As a bonus, 6 crab pots are set at the beginning of each tour (ocean conditions permitting), and picked up on the way back in - so be sure to get your shellfish permit (available at our office) if you would like to share in the fun! Hearty, healthy fishermen age 14 and older required for this fun
